_notes: Handkurerat 2026-10-23 ur Glasgow Lifes egna venue-sidor (glasgowlife.org.uk, robots tillåter). Varje rad har source_url. Inga koordinater (ej belagda i källan). Parker utelämnade: drivs av Glasgow City Council (glasgow.gov.uk, Cloudflare-utmaning som aldrig kringgås). Kör 'python -m scripts.seed_facilities glasgow' först efter ägarens godkännande (regel 7).

facilities.name: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum
facilities.description: One of Glasgow Museums' venues, run by Glasgow Life.
facilities.accessibility_note: Accessible toilets on all floors; wheelchair and pram access to all public areas by lift; guide and assistance dogs welcome; hearing loop available.
facilities.parking_note: Car park with 58 spaces, including 10 Blue Badge bays; up to 1 hour £3.00, maximum stay 10 hours, pay by coins or the RingGo app. Blue Badge holders park free. The venue says the spaces on the west side of the building are currently closed and the car park is likely to be very busy: it recommends public transport. Overflow parking is on Bunhouse Road, next to Kelvin Hall.
facilities.visit_notes: Nearest Subway station is Kelvinhall (about half a mile). Buses stop at the front on Argyle Street (First 2, 3 and 77; McGill's 17).

facilities.name: Riverside Museum
facilities.description: Glasgow's museum of transport and technology, run by Glasgow Life.
facilities.fee_note: Free entry, no need to book; donations welcome.
facilities.accessibility_note: Changing Places facility on the ground floor near reception, available during opening hours with no key; wheelchair and pram access to all public areas by lift; guide and assistance dogs welcome.
facilities.parking_note: Car park with about 100 spaces, which fills quickly at weekends and in school holidays. Up to 1 hour £3.00, 1-2 hours £5.00, 2-3 hours £7.50; maximum stay 10 hours. Pay at the machine or with the RingGo app.

facilities.name: Gallery of Modern Art (GoMA)
facilities.description: Glasgow's gallery of contemporary art, run by Glasgow Life.
facilities.accessibility_note: Accessible toilet on the lower ground floor; guide and assistance dogs welcome, water bowls provided.

facilities.name: The Burrell Collection
facilities.address: Pollokshaws Road, Pollok Country Park, Glasgow G43 1AT
facilities.description: A Glasgow Museums venue inside Pollok Country Park, run by Glasgow Life.
facilities.accessibility_note: Two Changing Places toilets and nine other accessible toilets; accessible lift; only assistance dogs are permitted inside; the free shuttle bus has room for one wheelchair at a time.
facilities.parking_note: 19 accessible bays in front of the museum; parking is free for Blue Badge holders. Charges apply 10am-6pm daily: £5 for up to 4 hours, £10 all day, by pay and display or the RingGo app. Spaces are not guaranteed: once the car parks are full, staff redirect cars out of the park.

facilities.name: St Mungo Museum of Religious Life and Art
facilities.description: A Glasgow Museums venue about religious life and art, run by Glasgow Life.
facilities.fee_note: Free entry, no advance booking; donations welcome.
facilities.accessibility_note: Accessible toilet beside the accessible entrance; wheelchair and pram access to all public areas by lift, with free wheelchair hire at reception; hearing assistance system; guide and assistance dogs welcome.
facilities.parking_note: Pay and display parking and free disabled parking in the City Car Parks on Cathedral Street and Collins Street; 3 electric charging bays in the Collins Street car park.

facilities.name: Provand's Lordship
facilities.description: A Glasgow Museums venue, run by Glasgow Life.
facilities.accessibility_note: Guide and assistance dogs welcome. The venue says there is no hearing assistance system and the exhibits are not audio described.
facilities.parking_note: Pay and display parking and free disabled parking in the car park on Castle Street.

facilities.name: Kelvin Hall
facilities.description: A building shared by Glasgow Club (gym, sports halls, gymnastics), Glasgow Museums, the National Library of Scotland and the Hunterian, with a cafe and a soft-play area for ages 0-12.
facilities.fee_note: Free to enter; individual activities may charge.
services: Glasgow Club gym and sports halls
facilities.accessibility_note: Wheelchair and pram access to all public areas by lift, with free wheelchair hire at reception; Changing Places toilet; quiet room on the ground floor; sensory bags with ear defenders from reception; fixed loop hearing system; only assistance dogs are permitted.
facilities.parking_note: Paid parking at the Bunhouse Road car park (maximum stay 10 hours, coins or the RingGo app); Blue Badge bays near the entrance on Bunhouse Road; electric charging via ChargePlace Scotland.
facilities.visit_notes: Partner organisations and the cafe may keep different hours from the building.

facilities.name: The Mitchell Library
facilities.hours_text: Mon 9am-5pm, Tue 9am-8pm, Wed 9am-5pm, Thu 9am-8pm, Fri 9am-5pm, Sat 9am-5pm, Sun closed
facilities.description: A large public library that also houses Glasgow City Archives.
services: Books in Braille, large print and audio
facilities.accessibility_note: Accessible toilet about 26m from the main entrance; fixed loop hearing system; a wheelchair to borrow; motorised scooters allowed in public areas; guide and assistance dogs welcome.
facilities.parking_note: Metered on-street parking Mon-Fri 8am-6pm. The NCP car park on India Street, next to Charing Cross station, is a 2-minute walk away.
facilities.visit_notes: There are no locker or cloakroom facilities.

facilities.name: Gorbals Library
facilities.hours_text: Mon 10am-5pm, Tue 10am-8pm, Wed 10am-5pm, Thu 10am-8pm, Fri 10am-5pm, Sat 10am-5pm, Sun closed
facilities.description: A Glasgow Life public library in the Gorbals.
facilities.accessibility_note: Accessible toilet about 14m from the main entrance; portable loop hearing system; assistance dogs welcome.
facilities.parking_note: The library does not have its own car parking.

facilities.name: Glasgow International Arena
facilities.hours_text: Mon-Fri 6am-10pm, Sat 8am-6pm, Sun 8am-8pm (last admission 1 hour before closing)
facilities.description: A Glasgow Club sports and fitness venue with a velodrome, a 100m indoor running track and a gym.
facilities.accessibility_note: Changing Places toilets; guide and assistance dogs welcome.
facilities.parking_note: Free. The main car park is on the left and the overflow car park on the right; both can be very busy at major events.
facilities.visit_notes: Dalmarnock station is a short walk away. Pitch and court booking: 0141 287 7000, option 4.

facilities.name: Tollcross International Swimming Centre
facilities.description: A Glasgow Club swimming and fitness centre.
facilities.accessibility_note: Changing Places toilets; guide and assistance dogs welcome.
facilities.visit_notes: The centre hosts events through the year, which may cause closures or restrictions: call 0141 276 8282 to check.

facilities.name: Glasgow Green Football Centre
facilities.description: A Glasgow Life football centre with floodlit 3G, synthetic and grass pitches.
